steps.description: Zone 1 easy spin, find rhythm, cadence 85-90 rpm, HR below 145
Zone 2 steady aerobic, HR 146-162 bpm, cadence 88-92 rpm, power is the anchor
Easy spin down, HR back below 140

name: Threshold Taste — 2x6min
focus: Brief threshold stimulus, sweet-spot to low Z4

steps.description: Build gradually: first 4 min Z1 (88-106W), next 4 min low Z2 (115-135W), cadence 88-92 rpm
Sweet-spot to low Z4 threshold, HR 163-175 bpm, cadence 90+ rpm, smooth and controlled
Easy spin, let HR drop below 155 before next rep
Full spin-down, HR below 135 before stopping

name: Lower Body & Core
focus: Leg and core strength endurance, shoulder-safe
notes: 2 rounds: 12x goblet squat 16kg, 10x RDL 16kg each leg, 10x TRX split squat each leg, 20x banded glute bridge, 8x dead bug each side, 25s side plank each side. 45-60s rest between exercises, 90s between rounds. No overhead loading — shoulder protected throughout.

steps.description: Leg swings front/back and lateral (10 each leg), hip circles (10 each direction), 15 bodyweight squats, 10 glute bridges
2 rounds of main circuit: goblet squat, RDL, TRX split squat, banded glute bridge, dead bug, side plank. 45-60s rest between exercises, 90s between rounds
Hip flexor stretch 60s each side, hamstring stretch 45s each side, glute figure-4 stretch 45s each side
